answers.explanation: A link already near capacity has nothing left for a bad day.
Micro-segmentation enforces need to know: getting into one zone doesn't give you the rest.
Load sharing splits traffic across paths, not necessarily evenly.
One backhoe cuts both. Real redundancy needs physically separate routes.
Everything else depends on them: without routing nothing moves, without DNS nothing is found.
Reload is faster and gentler. A restart stops the service and drops every connection.
On Cisco gear, reload reboots the whole device. Know what the word means on each platform.
TTR, time to recover or repair. Averaged over many incidents, it's MTTR.
Putting infrastructure services on multiple servers is network resourcefulness.
